deploy-bot: Deploy attempt for tag v2.14.0 -> staging (canary) started by @oliver. Commit: 2f9b3d4. CI gate: FAILED — 2 checks failed. See CI: https://ci.redwood/builds/345 :warning:

oliver (Oliver Kim): saw the bot, investigating. which checks failed? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Failed checks: integration-tests/payments (job #345) — timeout; e2e/clickpath (job #346) — selector timeout/flake. Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/345/logs and /346/logs

maiah (Maiah Chen): I can take payments job. @lucy can you look at e2e? :hand:

lucy (Lucy Rivera): on it, rerunning e2e job now: `ci retry job 346`

oliver (Oliver Kim): note — canary -> prod rollout is BLOCKED until CI gate passes. we'll need to decide pin vs wait if this is >30m.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by CI gate. Status: PAUSED. Auto-rollback: disabled. Pause timeout: 30m.

sre-team-bot: FYI @release-oncall (Dana) — CI gate failing for canary. Suggest manual rerun or abort depending on rerun results.

lucy (Lucy Rivera): e2e rerun PASSED :tada: logs https://ci.redwood/builds/346/logs

maiah (Maiah Chen): payments job still failing. looks like DB connection timeout in logs. Running a focused repro: `pytest tests/payments/test_charge.py::test_large_amount -k 2f9b3d4`

oliver (Oliver Kim): ok hold canary. Maiah, please open a hotfix branch with DB pool tweak and trigger CI. if CI for hotfix passes within our change window (1h) we proceed; otherwise we'll pin prod to v2.13.9 and schedule hotfix.

maiah (Maiah Chen): created hotfix/payments-pool branch, pushed commit 3a7c9ef. Triggering CI now.

deploy-bot: New CI run started for hotfix (job #347) — triggered by @maiah.

sre-team-bot: monitoring builds #345 #347, will notify when both gates green.

oliver (Oliver Kim): thanks. I'm updating the release notes draft to call out rollback threshold and change window.

release-oncall (Dana): noted. If hotfix CI fails, i'll coordinate pin to v2.13.9 and open rollout rollback ticket. tagging @eng-releases for visibility. :spiral_notepad:

lucy (Lucy Rivera): filing issue to mark e2e/clickpath flaky so it doesn't block non-regression gates.

maiah (Maiah Chen): hotfix CI #347 PASSED :white_check_mark:. Ready to redeploy canary? /cc @oliver

deploy-bot: Canary redeploy for tag hotfix/payments-pool (3a7c9ef) initiated by @maiah. CI gate running.

oliver (Oliver Kim): proceed. we'll run canary at 5% traffic for 15m. if any regression, manual rollback. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary successful — CI gates green and health checks OK. Rollout resumed and scheduled for prod change window.

release-oncall (Dana): Locking change window 22:00-23:00 UTC and finalizing release notes. If anything else crops up, reopen thread. Closing for now. :lock:
